notes.title: Online services temporarily unavailable
notes.content:
Dear Horrible friends, attention please!

Online services for our digital board games are temporarily suspended starting September 30th because our provider GameSparks is ceasing operation.

We are working on a new, better online integration which will be online in the next few months and available in an update. Meanwhile, all offline modes are fully operational.

Sincerely yours,
Horrible Guild

notes.title: The King's Dilemma: Chronicles | A single player, narrative-driven political RPG
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665987/52924708e2edfc61f8ce8533a42bbfc4a56c8ef3.jpg[/img]

We are delighted to announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2069180?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=KIDDIBT_reveal&utm_medium=news]The King's Dilemma: Chronicles[/url], a brand new single player video game based on our critically acclaimed legacy board game, The King's Dilemma. 

Travel back to the Kingdom of Ankist and play as the Head of the Council, the leader of the King’s inner circle. Will you listen to the advice of your Council of Houses, or will you overrule their decisions?

[img]https://img.mailinblue.com/2985969/images/rnb/original/62d01a3beee18f6e36724492.jpg[/img]
 
Face hundreds of dilemmas where every decision you make may affect your relationship with the other Houses, influence the well-being and resources of the kingdom, and change the course of history itself. 

Relive the story from the board game spanning across tens of generations, form alliances, survive betrayals, and prepare for the final uprising foretold by an ancient prophecy.

[img]https://img.mailinblue.com/2985969/images/rnb/original/62d01a3b98c3050baa604050.jpg[/img]

The game is being developed by Big Trouble, an indie video game developer and publisher based in Milan.

The studio was founded by none other than Lorenzo Silva, CEO and founder of Horrible Guild and creator of critically acclaimed board games such as Potion Explosion, Dungeon Fighter, the Railroad Ink series, and of course, The King’s Dilemma.

Big Trouble is a new venture in the world of video games, with more than a decade of experience in crafting physical games!

For more information about Big Trouble, check the [url=https://www.bigtroublegamestudio.com/?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=KIDDIBT_reveal&utm_medium=news]official website[/url], and don't forget to add The King's Dilemma: Chronicles to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2069180?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=KIDDIBT_reveal&utm_medium=news]Steam Wishlist[/url]!

notes.title: New DLC released! Introducing Similo: Wild Animals!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665987/70014535747121c4dff1dbe0726152a111a4c46b.jpg[/img]

We're glad to announce that Similo: Wild Animals, the latest downloadable deck for Similo: The Card Game, is available right now on the App Store, Google Play, and Steam as an in-app purchase!
 
Similo: The Card Game is the digital adaptation of our critically acclaimed cooperative guessing game illustrated by world famous artist Naïade. This new downloadable deck includes many of the wildest animals like the Lion, the Zebra, the Flamingo, the Elephant, the Iguana, the Crocodile and many more!

Join players from all over the world in the online multiplayer mode, or play locally with your friends in the Local Pass & Play mode!

But wait, there's more! To celebrate the launch of the new deck, we're hosting a live streamed game with game designer Hjalmar Hach and two special guests from BoardGameGeek: W. Eric Martin and Derek Porter! The game will be streamed here on Steam, as well as on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/horriblegames]Twitch[/url], [url=https://youtu.be/3T92XSMnu3A]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/horribleguild/videos/258837085869671]Facebook[/url] channels!

notes.title: Free weekend for Similo: The Card Game! Also, our whole catalog up to 77% off!
notes.content:
Friendly reminder! [url=www.castletricon.com/]Castle Tricon 2021: Spring Edition[/url], the digital convention that we are co-hosting with [b]Heidelbär Games[/b] and [b]Czech Games Edition[/b], is starting tomorrow!

The event will be open to the public on [b]February 26th and 27th[/b] and it is [b]free for all to attend[/b] – so come join us and let's have some fun! notes.title: Quick Games + New Expansion!
notes.content:
You requested it and now it's here! A new synch multiplayer mode called QUICK GAMES.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665987/672b58b95505978f1738180a1510f8e3150c404c.png[/img]

Create a quick game as you would a normal online game and pick how many seconds a turn can last.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665987/d8f3c94c50d90464a16ed272a751326038cd65d2.png[/img]

Then wait until anyone joins your game, and you will have to play the whole match in one sitting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665987/4f9354694da8a01e743d41b31285031583108f19.png[/img]

Plus Christmas background! (you can now change backgrounds in the options, bringing back the cool Halloween theme with scary music!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665987/f3501a063a76c82fa2adff2d9f41ab76b1c4c2ff.png[/img]

Thank you everyone for your patience and support! Please let u know what you think of the latest update in the comments!

notes.title: Play with the Author!
notes.content:
Join the stream, scheduled as part of the Steam Digital Tabletop Fest and the SPIEL.digital, and challenge the author of the original card game SIMILO! 

Hjalmar and other talents from Horrible Guild will join the stream and play with you via the chat, or you can log online in the game itself and challenge them. 

See you Friday!

notes.title: Similo: Spookies!
notes.content:
[b]Don’t be (too) afraid![/b]

Werewolf, Vampire, Mummy, Witch, Zombie, and many more: all the spookiest creatures from your favorite tales are ready to join your Halloween party!

Available only in the digital version of Similo: The Card Game, a new DLC for Halloween, with 29 of the best-known creatures and monsters.

And remember, you can mix and match Similo: Spookies with all the other available decks!
